US F-35 and Apache helicopters join India-US military exercises

The United States' F-35 stealth fighter jet is set to participate in an air exercise in Rajasthan, while the AH-64E Apache attack helicopters have joined the India-US Army exercise 'Yudh Abhyas 2026'. The specific dates for the F-35 participation were not detailed in the coverage.
